# SGLang 0.5.15 synthetic contracts

Generated with `PYTHONPATH=src:. python scripts/generate_sglang_direct_contracts.py`.
These are CPU/fake protocol and serialization snapshots. `synthetic-runtime.json`
contains placeholder local paths/file hashes, not an installed or runnable runtime.
The study and its four policy populations are `SYNTHETIC_ONLY`, `UNVERIFIED`, and
not evidence eligible. They do not qualify a GPU, driver, JIT compiler or engine.
